translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content.text: Yawe nide King, kx myaszlzle enjrl kcng tzmatqng tztu-ngalelvzlr tron nyzde.
X leplz amrlx mz nrlc tulvzo narnrcti-lzbqtr-ngrbzlr bade.
Yawe matq-esz'ngr Jerusalem.
X nzmyalz-esz'ngr-krde myaszpxle lr mrkzbleng amrlx.
Leplz amrlx naglqlzlr drtqde,
Murde nide kc tqtr-esz'ngr.
King kc tqrninr, mrlz-zvzbz bam da kxmrlz.
Delc nzaclve-zvz-krm nigr tqtubq-zvz-ngrde x rsakrlrngr.
Nayrngzobzku mz nanyc Yawe,
Mrkc tqwxbu-ngrde mz tron nyzde.
Na-angioku x naglqlzku Gct rgu,
Murde nide kc tqtr-esz'ngr.
Mosis x Eron nidr pris neng Yawe, x profet Samwel krka'bz bade.
Nzyrnitrpzng bade x ayzlubzle natqdr.
Ycmnepxm badr mz nabz dcbz,
X nzvz-nqblqlr natqde x lou scdeng amrlx.
Yawe, nim Gct rgr,
X ayzlume natqgr, nigr leplz nemqng.
Kxmule-esz' ayrplapx-kaiq nigr mz alwx ngrgrng,
A' sc tqaelwapxpe-ngrn kx nim Gct kx krlzle nzipq-krde leplz.
Naglqlzku Yawe, Gct rgu, mz nzangio-krgu nide mz newz kxtr nyzde,
Murde nide kc tqtr-esz'ngr.
